more_sheet.surface: bg-wz-bg rounded-t-[20px] absolute bottom-0 w-full pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]
more_sheet.header: flex justify-between items-center p-4 border-b border-wz-border sticky top-0 bg-wz-bg z-10 rounded-t-[20px]
more_sheet.close_behavior: swipe-down to close, tap backdrop to close, explicit close button (X) top right
more_sheet.elements: remaining nav items (as standard horizontal rows with icon + label + chevron), role pill, sign-out button (at bottom, text-wz-negative)

mobile_topbar.layout: flex justify-between items-center px-4 pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)] h-[calc(56px+env(safe-area-inset-top))]
mobile_topbar.elements_center: Page Title (text-sm font-medium text-wz-text-primary truncate max-w-[150px]) - optional

theme_toggle_ux.interaction: click cycles to next state, persists to localStorage('theme-preference'). 'Auto' applies OS prefers-color-scheme. Modifies <html data-theme='...'>
theme_toggle_ux.styling: p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-wz-surface-hover text-wz-text-secondary transition-colors h-10 w-10 flex items-center justify-center

responsive_guidance.data_display: Tables -> Card stack on mobile. Hide less critical columns on md. Flip entirely to stacked layout (row = card) on <md.
responsive_guidance.typography: text-2xl -> lg:text-3xl for main headers, text-sm -> lg:text-base for body text where appropriate.
responsive_guidance.sidebar_layout: lg:block hidden fixed w-[260px] h-screen border-r border-wz-border bg-wz-surface

safe_area_considerations.bottom_inset: Apply `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]` to Bottom Tab Bar and More Sheet surface bottom.
safe_area_considerations.top_inset: Apply `pt-[env(safe-area-inset-top)]` to Mobile Topbar and ensure the height includes it.
safe_area_considerations.min_touch_target: Ensure all interactive elements (tabs, toggle, sheet rows) have at least 44x44px tappable area.

testing_attributes.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
